title: brassica campestris subsp. pekinensis
intro: Brassica campestris subsp. pekinensis, commonly known as Chinese broccoli or gai lan, is a variety of the Brassica campestris plant. It is a cool-season crop rich in nutrients, including vitamins C and K, and is also a good source of fiber and antioxidants. The health benefits of Chinese broccoli include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its high content of isothiocyanates, which have been shown to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Chinese broccoli include glucosinolates, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its ability to stimulate the immune system and protect against cancer.
